name: Dailygram
tagline: The personal digest pipeline is a realistic weekend build if you bring feeds or a data provider. Reliable ingestion from Instagram, X, TikTok, and LinkedIn is not a one-shot project: access restrictions, changing page formats, rate limits, and connector maintenance are the product's durable edge.
